title: Anti-Doping Terminology Match
description: Match each critical anti-doping term with its correct definition.

pairs.definition: Athlete is solely responsible for any substance found in their body.
Official exemption permitting an athlete to use a necessary medication.
Period starting 11:59 PM before the event through the end of testing.
The annual global list identifying banned substances and methods.

title: Clean Sport Word Scramble
description: Unscramble the letters to reveal this crucial anti-doping principle.
hint: The use of prohibited substances or methods to artificially alter performance.

title: Spot the High-Risk Product
description: Which of these 4 product descriptions shows the highest risk of containing unlisted prohibited substances?

options.text: Brand A: Plain rolled oats with organic dried cranberries and USDA organic seal
Brand B: 'Extreme Underground Anabolic Igniter' with proprietary herbal matrix claiming 15 lbs muscle in 2 weeks
Brand C: Electrolyte hydration tabs with NSF Certified for Sport badge and batch lot number
Brand D: Pure Vitamin C 500mg tablets from a licensed domestic pharmacy

explanation: Proprietary formulas claiming rapid, extreme hormonal results frequently contain illicit stimulants, SARMs, or steroid analogues not listed on the label.

title: Substance Scramble: Anabolic Agent
description: Unscramble this banned beta-2 agonist and anabolic agent often abused for rapid fat loss.
hint: A prohibited substance under WADA S1.2 that can cause severe heart palpitations.

title: Label Inspection Challenge
description: True or False: If a dietary supplement is sold in a major retail health store, it is guaranteed 100% free of WADA-prohibited substances.
statement: If a dietary supplement is sold in a major retail health store, it is guaranteed 100% free of WADA-prohibited substances.
explanation: FALSE. Retail stores sell thousands of products with varied supply chains. Store stocking does not equate to independent anti-doping batch testing.

title: Substance Classification Match
description: Match each substance with its official category under the WADA Prohibited List.

pairs.definition: S3. Beta-2 Agonists (Permitted via inhalation within limits)

title: Nutritional Science Scramble
description: Unscramble this naturally occurring organic compound widely permitted in sports nutrition.
hint: Stored in muscles as phosphocreatine and widely researched for explosive power.

title: Find the Misleading Advice
description: Identify the statement that represents dangerous misinformation for an athlete.

options.text: Drinking water with a pinch of salt helps replace sweat electrolyte losses during long endurance runs.
If a pill comes from a plant, you can take as much as you want because natural ingredients never get flagged on doping tests.
Athletes should check their prescription asthma inhalers on Global DRO to verify permitted inhalation dose limits.
Consuming 20-30g of dietary protein every 3-4 hours supports optimal muscle protein synthesis.

explanation: Natural plants can contain potent prohibited alkaloids (like ephedrine or cannabis derivatives) or may be laced with synthetic chemicals.

title: The Whereabouts Rule
description: True or False: An athlete in the Registered Testing Pool can refuse an unannounced test if the DCO arrives before 7:00 AM.
statement: An athlete in the Registered Testing Pool can refuse an unannounced test if the DCO arrives before 7:00 AM.
explanation: FALSE. Testing can occur anytime, anywhere with no advance notice. Refusing or evading a sample collection is an Anti-Doping Rule Violation.

title: Integrity Scramble
description: Unscramble this word representing the core value of clean sport.
hint: Fair play, ethical respect, and honor in athletic competition.
